title: How User and AI Agent Avatars Improve Record Ownership in Business Central BC 28
summary: Business Central BC 28 adds visual avatars for record creators and modifiers on list pages, showing who created or last changed a record without opening the full card. This helps teams identify ownership, reduce duplicate work, and distinguish human-created from AI-generated records.
key_points: Avatars display creator and modifier information directly on list pages with full names and timestamps on hover
Feature supports named users, system users, and AI agents to reflect Microsoft's evolving identity model
Eliminates need to open card pages or check change logs to identify record responsibility and recent activity
Particularly valuable in multi-department environments where automation and AI processes work alongside human users

quotes.text: Multiple users, departments, integrations, and automated processes work on the same records.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the operational challenge that avatars solve in shared data environments

quotes.text: BC 28 helps distinguish human-created records, AI-generated records, system-generated changes.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights how the feature improves transparency and trust in automated processes
